headline: No single parameterization of the TvL engine — even with a pre-declared talent-leverage dial swept from pure luck to the paper's model — can jointly reproduce any real domain's signature triple: the model's winner is structurally too mediocre (reachable skill percentile ≤0.73 vs real ≥0.99) and its year-to-year ranks too sticky (~0.96 vs real 0.49–0.87).

tables.title: What the model can reach vs what the data show (study 001 measurements)

figures.caption: The two structural failures: (a) the engine's top-capital agent never exceeds the 0.73 talent percentile (blue band = reachable over all 55 grid cells) while tennis/movies winners sit at ~0.99; (b) model y2y persistence is pinned at ~0.96 while real domains fall at 0.49–0.87 and order chess>tennis>baseball. Error bars are ±2 SE.
figures.alt: Two panels. Left: tennis, movies dots near 1.0 far above a shaded model band 0.49-0.73; baseball dot at 1.0 with a wide error bar reaching the band. Right: chess, tennis, baseball dots descending from 0.87 to 0.49, all below a thin model band near 0.96.

figures.caption: T1 fit map on the α×p_L plane: each domain's nearest grid cell (marker) and 1-SE neighbourhood (dashed). Every joint 3-SE fit FAILS. Zappalà's per-point tennis band a=0.20–0.30 (orange) is overlaid but is a different construct from our career-level α.
figures.alt: Scatter on alpha (x) vs p_L (y): tennis and movies at (1.0,65), chess at (0.4,50), baseball at (0.3,20); a vertical orange band at alpha 0.2-0.3; all labelled fit FAILS.

figures.caption: T3 funding frontier: egalitarian (ALL-EQUAL-1u) vs elitarian (25%-BEST-10u) funding efficiency E=ΔP_T/F_T across the talent-leverage dial. Egalitarian wins by ~9× at every α — no flip in [0,1]. Engine-vs-engine only (no paper §3 value used as a reference band).
figures.alt: Two near-flat curves vs alpha: egalitarian around 0.005 well above elitarian around 0.0005 across the whole range; shaded gap between them; dotted line at alpha=1 marking fitted career alphas.

notes: T1 failure is the pre-declared falsification outcome (no cell fits all a domain's statistics within 3 SE), a finding against the TvL family's sufficiency — not an execution failure. Fitted α's are nearest cells of failed fits, not calibrated parameters.

All four validation gates pass: 001 completed & G1–G3 passed; the (α=1,p_L=50) anchor reproduces 001's tvl_reference.csv exactly (diff 0.00e+00, bit-identical α=1 path); literature traces to PROVENANCE.md (abstract-verified carry †); α=1 bit-identical to the staged engine.
Paper §3 funding caveat (travels with every citation): the paper's unreleased experiment code evidently differed from the released demo; one F_T cell is an arithmetic error (70000→50000).

Poker & MusicLab excluded from the T1 fit (TvL-A5 demotion; 001 gated ELSE branch). Csurilla et al. 2023 (named in T2) is absent from the staged PROVENANCE.md; recorded direction-only with no cited number.
